items.title: Special right to cancel before price increase takes effect
items.quote: Sie können den Vertrag ohne Einhaltung einer Kündigungsfrist zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung kündigen.
items.computation: The price change takes effect on 01.11.2026. The special termination right lets the customer end the contract effective on that same date, without a notice period. To take effect on 01.11.2026 (and thus avoid the higher price), the cancellation in text form must reach Muster Gas GmbH by the last day before the increase takes effect, i.e. 31.10.2026 (a Saturday, but this is a company, not an authority, so no BGB weekend-shift rule applies to the receipt deadline; the letter sets no formal 'Zugang' cutoff, only that termination is effective 'zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung'). Earliest safe reading: cancellation must arrive no later than 31.10.2026 to prevent the new price from applying.
